chunks: Abu Jamilyah from Zayd al-Shahham from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding the slave who kills a free man intentionally.

He said: One hundred of the mature camels (masann). If there are no camels, then for the place of each camel, twenty of the male sheep. As for the dirhams, ten thousand dirhams. And the earlier narrations point to that, and it is also confirmed by that.

key_terms.الْمَسَانَّ: Mature camels (specifically those in their fifth year)

ai.seo_question: What is the blood money for a slave who kills a free man?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfabar specifies the blood money (diyah) for a slave who intentionally kills a free man as one hundred mature camels (masan), with equivalent values in sheep or silver dirhams. It highlights the jurisprudential principle that the slave's compensation is drawn from their own assets, distinguishing it from the free man's liability, and is supported by earlier narrations within the Shia scholarly tradition.
